description: Labels of a second, independent reviewer (Claude, separate session) given only tenders.json, the knowledge base documents and draft_labels.json, never the system's answers. Quotes checked against the documents by verify step in build_sheet.py.

I01.evidence_quote: Delivered a full-stack Salesforce CRM covering leads, contacts, accounts and opportunities for a regional distributor.
I01.explanation: Completed 2025 CRM delivery (set-up, data onboarding, automation, SSO) proves supply and deployment of a CRM; maintenance of a CRM is not separately documented.

I02.explanation: Certification held by a person, but no delivered marketing-automation project; Marketing Cloud is only listed as a platform/offer.

I03.explanation: Administrative line (references to provide with the bid), missing by policy. Under another reading (comparable CRM projects) it would be covered/partial.

I04.evidence_quote: then Run phase (monitoring, access control, updates)
I04.explanation: Only related evidence: OliveSoft ran a completed HR integration platform (monitoring, access control, updates). No portal and no TMA contract. 'Predictive maintenance' (ML) is excluded as a false friend.
I04.agrees_with_draft: no (draft says missing; I count the run phase of a delivered application platform as related evidence)

I05.explanation: Fragment of 'corrective maintenance'. No document mentions corrective maintenance of applications; 'predictive maintenance' ML projects do not prove it.

I06.explanation: Fragment of 'preventive maintenance'. No document mentions preventive maintenance of applications; 'predictive maintenance' ML projects do not prove it.

I07.explanation: Fragment of 'adaptive maintenance'. No document mentions adaptive maintenance of applications; 'predictive maintenance' ML projects do not prove it.

I08.explanation: No document mentions evolutionary maintenance of applications. The Eventilo 'functional enhancements' (CV_12) are a 6-week sprint on a development, not a maintenance service.

I09.evidence_quote: 99.95 % uptime; provisioning time cut by 70 %; security vulnerabilities reduced by 45 %.
I09.explanation: Completed project with infrastructure hardening (DevSecOps scanning) and high availability, but not a security-and-resilience service offer for a health body.

I10.evidence_quote: Developed a centralised CMDB and ITSM workflow on Microsoft 365 for 150+ IT assets.
I10.explanation: An IT-asset inventory is related to an information-system map; no document describes a security cartography. CV_17 lists 'Enterprise Architecture: TOGAF, ArchiMate' (modelling, not a cartography project).

I11.explanation: No security-awareness or phishing campaign in any document.

I12.explanation: No crisis-management solution; 'collaborative' only appears as a soft skill or as Microsoft 365 training, which does not prove a collaboration solution.

I13.evidence_quote: Developed over 30 client-facing web applications using PHP, CodeIgniter, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
I13.explanation: PHP framework development (CodeIgniter, Laravel in Skills), an equivalent technology to Symfony; neither Typo3 nor Symfony appears anywhere.
I13.agrees_with_draft: yes (status agrees; I cite CV_14 (PHP frameworks) rather than CV_02 (PHP only))

I14.evidence_quote: Designed and implemented 12+ client-facing web modules using PHP, HTML5, and JavaScript
I14.explanation: Web development with counts and results, in two CVs.

I15.evidence_quote: Defined SOA standards that reduced service duplication by 30 % and accelerated time-to-market for new services.
I15.explanation: Software/application architecture work (SOA standards, EAI solution, 'Enterprise Architecture: ... Micro-services'). The line has no web or technology qualifier.
I15.agrees_with_draft: no (draft says partial because the architecture is enterprise-level; I read SOA standards as application architecture)

I16.evidence_quote: then Run phase (monitoring, access control, updates)
I16.explanation: Same related evidence as I04: run phase of a delivered application platform; no TMA contract is documented.

I17.evidence_quote: Designed and maintained Docker-based micro-service infrastructure for 12 production systems, with Prometheus and Grafana monitoring.
I17.explanation: Infrastructure operation, monitoring and a run phase, but no hosting or managed-service (infogérance) of a web platform.

I18.evidence_quote: Power Platform mobile app, real-time bi-directional Salesforce sync, calls, SMS and email features.
I18.explanation: Completed 2024 low-code delivery on Power Platform, an equivalent type of platform; no OutSystems and no TMA.

I19.explanation: Completed projects with user acceptance testing (also 'Scoping, data migration, UAT and production go-live'). CV_12's acceptance testing sits in an ongoing project, so I do not use it.
I19.agrees_with_draft: yes (status agrees; I avoid CV_12 because its project is ongoing)

I20.evidence_quote: Implemented RBAC, authentication, and metadata management, enhancing security compliance (ISO 27001) across the workflow ecosystem.
I20.explanation: Security practices inside delivery work (RBAC, DevSecOps scanning, ISO 27001 compliance mention), but no information-security service, certificate or audit.

I21.evidence_quote: Designed and implemented a hybrid lake-warehouse architecture that reduced data duplication by 20 % and storage costs by 15 %.
I21.explanation: Architecture work with measured gains on cloud and data platforms; not applied to an OutSystems application park.

I22.explanation: No hosting of a ticketing (billettique) system. 'Ticket' in the documents means support tickets (ITSM).

I23.explanation: No ticketing-system administration in any document.
